rows: Managers may set lineups and change players' positions from a list of their eligible positions.
Lineup deadline is five minutes before gametime for each player.
Add/Drops are handled by a waivers process.
Transactions will lock five minutes before the first game on Sunday (excluding Europe games). Players whose teams already played will be locked for the remainder of the scoring period.
The waiver process runs on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday night.
The waiver order resets after each weeks' games.
Dropped players remain on waivers for at least 1 day(s).
Each team will have a starting budget of $100.
Managers may not make trades during the offseason.
